basic_info.description: Bright and inviting classic 1920s detached home filled with character and natural light. Surrounded by windows on all sides, this residence offers a warm and inviting atmosphere in a highly desirable neighborhood. Step inside to a dramatic foyer with a gracious formal living room with a vaulted ceiling, center fireplace, and refinished hardwood floors throughout. The large formal dining room flows seamlessly into the spacious, updated kitchen and a cozy breakfast room ideal as a sunny nook or flexible home office. All three bedrooms and one bathroom are conveniently located on the main level. The rear bedrooms overlook the charming garden and walkout deck, offering a peaceful retreat. The spacious garage offers 2 car parking, abundant storage, and a laundry area. Ideally located near the vibrant West Portal Village shopping district, local park, MUNI, freeway access, and schools. This storybook home in Old Miraloma blends timeless elegance with modern comfort, a rare find in today's market.
